snapshot.incomplete_or_budget_exceeded_policy: no explicit early events; retain direct and conservative late fallback

candidate_selection.score: sum of bounded low/mid/high energy gains
candidate_selection.visibility: continuous local-plane intersection plus two-leg voxel DDA traversal/budget and exact optimized VoxelShape AABB segment occlusion
candidate_selection.coarse_cell_rule: a Minecraft block cell is not treated as fully solid merely because its collision shape is non-empty
candidate_selection.exact_shape_rule: each leg is rejected only when it enters the epsilon-shrunken interior of a captured optimized VoxelShape AABB; the air-side reflection endpoint must not self-occlude

events.energy: sum selected path energy per cluster

cache.identity: exact snapshot generation plus canonical source/listener IEEE-754 coordinates
